main_result: The lifted addition law exists, but its missing factor is the canonical modular carry cocycle. A diagonal carry after public halving is parity itself.
closed_classes: direct binary lifted-addition state with an assumed carry bit
normalized binary carry-free gauge beyond parity
base-field multiplicative carry-free scalar gauge beyond parity
generator-blind standard addition circuits as carry evaluators
fixed separated linear carry dictionaries below rank n
fixed-jump carry monomials with fewer than n-1 factors
ordinary direct rational carry fibres below pole degree n-1
claim_boundary: No unrestricted nonlinear-circuit lower bound, parity oracle, sub-root evaluator, or sub-square-root ECDLP algorithm is claimed.
